column1: # Observed-scale SNP heritability estimated with LDSC v1.0.1 (--h2) using the precomputed 1000 Genomes European-ancestry LD Scores. N_SNPs = variants remaining after merging with the regression LD Score panel; counts differ between the BAG phenotypes and the two external ageing traits because of differences in summary-statistic coverage. h2_Z = h2/h2_SE; h2_P is a one-sided normal-theory P value. Ratio = (Intercept − 1)/(Mean_Chi2 − 1) and becomes unstable as Mean_Chi2 approaches 1.

# Ratio = (Intercept − 1)/(Mean_Chi2 − 1); the statistic is inflated when Mean_Chi2 approaches 1 and therefore reflects statistical power as well as confounding. Telomere length PC1 has the largest absolute intercept excess (0.113) but the lowest ratio (0.112), reflecting its substantially larger discovery sample. h2_P is a one-sided normal-theory P value.
